map.使用 Siamese（连续摆数）法生成奇数阶幻方。幻方每行、每列、两条对角线之和: Generates odd-order magic squares using the Siamese (continuous placement) method. In a magic square, every row, column and the two diagonals sum to the same value.
map.奇数阶幻方：幻和 M = n(n² + 1) ÷ 2；生成用 Siamese 法: Odd-order magic square: magic sum M = n(n² + 1) / 2; generation uses the Siamese method - place the first number in the middle of the top row, then move up-right for each subsequent number, wrapping around at the boundaries, and if the target cell is occupied move down one row; verify that every row, column and both diagonals sum to the magic sum.
map.📐 幻方与 Siamese 方法: 📐 Magic Square and the Siamese Method
map.n×n 方阵，填入 1~n² 的数字，使每行、每列、两条对角线之和相同。: An n×n matrix filled with numbers 1 to n² so that every row, column and the two diagonals have the same sum.
map.M = n(n²+1)/2，即每行/列/对角线的和。: M = n(n²+1)/2, i.e. the sum of each row / column / diagonal.
map.1. 将 1 放在第一行中间；: 1. Place 1 in the middle of the top row;
map.2. 后续数字向「右上」移动一格（行-1，列+1）；: 2. Move each subsequent number one cell up-right (row-1, col+1);
map.3. 若超出上边界则移到最底行；超出右边界则移到最左列；: 3. If it goes past the top edge, move to the bottom row; if past the right edge, move to the leftmost column;
map.4. 若目标格已填，则回到正下方一格继续。: 4. If the target cell is already filled, go back one cell directly below and continue.

map.算例：5 阶幻方常数: Example: Magic constant of a 5th-order square
map.幻方常数 M=n(n²+1)/2。对 n=5，M=5×(25+1)/2=65。生: Magic constant M = n(n²+1)/2. For n=5, M = 5×(25+1)/2 = 65. In the generated square, every row, every column and both main diagonals sum to 65.
map.取暹罗法生成的 5 阶幻方，首行和 = 65，主对角线（左上到右下）和 = 65: Take a 5th-order square from the Siamese method: the first-row sum = 65, the main diagonal (top-left to bottom-right) sum = 65, and the other rows/columns/anti-diagonal are the same. Derivation: the total of 1...n² = n²(n²+1)/2, divided evenly into n rows gives each row sum = n(n²+1)/2.
map.奇阶、偶阶幻方构造方法一样吗？: Are the construction methods the same for odd-order and even-order magic squares?
map.不一样。奇阶（n 为奇数）可用暹罗法：从顶行居中开始，向右上走，越界绕回，被占则: No. Odd order (n odd) can use the Siamese method: start from the top row center, move up-right, wrap at boundaries, move down one cell if occupied. Even order (singly/doubly even) needs different algorithms (e.g. Strachey method, diagonal method); this tool generally supports odd order most completely.
map.幻方常数怎么来的？: Where does the magic constant come from?
map.数字 1…n² 之和为 n²(n²+1)/2，平均分配到 n 行（或 n 列），: The sum of numbers 1...n² is n²(n²+1)/2, evenly distributed over n rows (or n columns), so each row should equal the total divided by n, i.e. n(n²+1)/2. This is the equal-sum baseline that any n-th order magic square must satisfy.
